The powerful 6.7L V8 Power Stroke diesel turbocharged engine delivers the towing and payload capacity you need, paired with a smooth 10-speed automatic transmission and rugged 4WD. This F-250SD is built for serious work and serious comfort. Come see this capable King Ranch in our showroom and experience the combination of diesel power, advanced technology, and premium finishes that makes this truck a standout choice.

description:
The 2019 GMC Sierra 1500 SLT in pristine white represents a capable workhorse built for those who demand both performance and refinement. With its muscular EcoTec3 5.3L V8 engine paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission and 4WD capability, this truck delivers the power and traction you need for any terrain or task.

This truck comes exceptionally well-equipped with premium amenities:

- 20 inch Force Offroad wheels with 35 Mickey Thompson all-terrain tires
- Power sunroof
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration
- Premium GMC Infotainment System with navigation
- Premium Bose 7-speaker sound system with SiriusXM
- X31 Off-Road Package with off-road suspension and hill descent control
- Spray-on bed liner with GMC logo
- Chrome assist steps and grille
- Heated and ventilated front seats with 10-way power adjustment
- Trailer Tire Pressure Monitor System and integrated trailer brake controller
- Lane Keep Assist, lane change alert, and forward collision alert
- Rear cross traffic alert and ultrasonic park assist
- Keyless open and start
- Remote vehicle starter system
- Lift kit for enhanced stance and capability

The SLT Premium Plus Package elevates your experience with convenience features, driver alert systems, and refined styling touches. The X31 package adds serious off-road credibility with an upgraded suspension, hill descent control, and protective skid plates. Whether you're navigating city streets or tackling challenging terrain, the advanced safety technologies provide confidence and peace of mind.

Inside, perforated leather-appointed seating with heated front seats and a heated steering wheel creates a comfortable environment regardless of season. The truck bed is protected with its spray-on liner, while the tri-fold tonneau cover keeps your cargo secure. Dual exhaust with premium tips and a heavy-duty rear locking differential round out the mechanical sophistication.

At 42,227 miles, this Sierra has been well-maintained and still offers plenty of service life ahead. The white exterior keeps the truck looking clean and professional, while all the mechanical and comfort systems remain in top working order.

This is a truck that works as hard as you do while providing the comfort and technology you've come to expect. Schedule your test drive today and experience how the Sierra 1500 SLT can serve your lifestyle.

This stunning 2022 Audi Q7 55 Premium Plus quattro delivers refined performance and luxury in an elegant black finish. With just over 18,000 miles, this three-row SUV combines sophisticated engineering with everyday practicality. Powered by a 3.0L TFSI engine paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission and quattro all-wheel drive, it offers a responsive driving experience.

Key Features:
- Audi MMI Navigation plus with Touch Response
- Panoramic power moonroof
- Heated front bucket seats with leather upholstery
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto smartphone integration
- Audi Sound System with 10 speakers and SiriusXM
- Rear-view camera with parking assistance
- Electronic stability control and four-wheel independent suspension
- Dual-zone front air conditioning with rear climate control
- Alloy wheels with all-season tire pressure monitoring
- Split-folding rear seat with reclining third-row bench seating

This Q7 is equipped with comprehensive safety technology including dual front airbags, side-impact protection, overhead airbags, and emergency communication via Audi connect. The interior showcases premium leather seating, power adjustable driver and passenger seats with memory functions, and genuine wood accents throughout. Automatic headlights with delay-off feature, rear fog lights, and rain-sensing wipers enhance both safety and convenience.

The cabin reflects Audi's commitment to luxury with power windows, remote keyless entry, a leather-wrapped steering wheel with mounted controls, and HomeLink garage door transmitter integration. Climate management extends to the rear with independent air conditioning and a rear window defroster for year-round comfort.

We invite you to visit our showroom to experience this sophisticated Q7 firsthand and discover why it's an exceptional choice for discerning drivers who demand both performance and refinement.

description: Mashburn Motors is pleased to offer this exceptionally preserved 2008 Ford Mustang Shelby GT500 with just 14,130 original miles. Finished in beautiful Vapor Silver Metallic with Ebony Le Mans stripes, this two-owner GT500 has a clean, accident-free CARFAX and remains remarkably original, unmodified and unmolested something becoming increasingly difficult to find among these early modern Shelby GT500s. Under the hood is Ford's supercharged 5.4-liter DOHC V8 producing 500 horsepower and 480 lb-ft of torque, backed by the original Tremec 6-speed manual transmission. The engine compartment remains factory in appearance, right down to the original air intake and supercharger arrangement. No cold-air intake, aftermarket pulley, tuner, exhaust system or collection of modifications to undo this is the way Ford and SVT built it. The condition is exceptional throughout. The Vapor Silver paint and factory-style Ebony stripes present beautifully, the original GT500 wheels are outstanding, and the exterior shows the kind of preservation expected from a carefully kept 14,000-mile automobile. The black leather interior is equally impressive, retaining its original Shelby seating, factory Shaker audio system, instrumentation, trim and virtually every detail that made these cars special when new. Even underneath, this Shelby tells an honest story. Rather than having been cosmetically refinished or sprayed to look new, the undercarriage remains remarkably original, showing factory finishes, labels and components along with only the minor natural aging one would expect from an 18-year-old automobile. It's exactly the kind of underside we like to see on a genuine low-mile collector car. Documentation is another strong point. Included are the original window sticker, Ford/SVT documentation, owner's materials, keys and remotes, and the Ford SVT certificate. That certificate identifies this car as #5,973 of 6,513 GT500 coupes produced for 2008 and #900 of only 971 manufactured in Vapor Silver. The original window sticker shows an MSRP of $46,120 including destination, with desirable equipment including the GT500 Premium Trim Package, HID headlamps, Ebony tape stripes and full vehicle cover. The 9 Shelby GT500 has become an important part of modern Mustang history. These cars marked the return of the Shelby GT500 name and combined unmistakable retro Mustang styling with a hand-built supercharged V8, 6-speed manual transmission and 500 horsepower serious performance then and still serious performance today. There are plenty of GT500s available that have accumulated miles, been modified, tuned, pulley-swapped and subsequently returned to stock. Finding one with just 14,130 original miles that has simply remained the way Ford built it is an entirely different proposition. This is an excellent example for the enthusiast who wants to drive and enjoy one of these cars, and an equally compelling automobile for the collector who values low mileage, originality, documentation and preservation. 14,130 original miles. Vapor Silver. 6-speed manual. Supercharged 5.4-liter V8. Accident-free history. Completely stock and unmolested. Original window sticker and SVT certificate. That's a hell of a nice package. For more info contact Kevin at Mashburn Motors. Visit Mashburn Motors  to see more pictures of this vehicle or call us at   today to schedule your test drive.

1-Owner vehicle

All-Weather Confidence Meets Chicagoland Luxury
For daily commuters, active families, and weekend road-trippers across Bartlett, Elgin, Schaumburg, Streamwood, Hoffman Estates, and St. Charles, finding a versatile crossover that handles severe Midwest winters with ease while surrounding you in premium comfort is essential. Backed by a 4-Star Overall Government Safety Rating, this range-topping 2021 Nissan Rogue Platinum AWD offers a quiet, athletic, and sophisticated driving experience tailored specifically for northern Illinois roads.

Draped in a stunning, multi-stage Pearl White Tricoat exterior factory paint ($395.00 value) and paired with an opulent Tan interior featuring Quilted Semi-Aniline Leather-Appointed Seats, this flagship crossover presents a commanding presence on local streets. Whether traveling down Route 20, commuting along the Interstate 90 tollway into Chicago, or navigating Cook and DuPage counties during a winter snowfall, this Rogue surrounds every occupant in executive luxury.

Under the hood sits a responsive 2.5L DOHC 16-Valve 4-Cylinder Engine delivering 181 horsepower and 181 lb-ft of torque, paired with an XTRONIC CVT® featuring a manual mode with paddle shifters. Power is delivered dynamically via Nissan's Intelligent All-Wheel Drive System with a Drive Mode Dial featuring specialized Terrain Modes. Commuters will appreciate its balanced performance, achieving an EPA-estimated 32 MPG on the highway and 25 MPG in the city (28 MPG combined rating).

Range-Topping Platinum Features & Added Equipment Pricing
As the flagship Platinum trim level, this 2021 Rogue comes outfitted straight from the factory with premier luxury amenities alongside practical protective equipment:

Added Features & Accessories Pricing Breakdown:
Illuminated Kick Plates $400.00: Glowing interior door sill plates designed to protect thresholds while adding a distinctive luxury accent.

Pearl White Tricoat Premium Paint $395.00: Multi-stage metallic white exterior paint finish.

Floor Mats, 2-Piece Cargo Area Protector, Seatback Protector & First Aid Kit $385.00: Complete interior protection suite including custom floor mats, rear cargo cover liners, seatback guards, and emergency medical kit.

Splash Guards $180.00: Custom-molded mud guards engineered to shield lower body panels from gravel, salt, and slush.

Chrome Rear Bumper Protector $170.00: Durable chrome bumper guard designed to prevent scuffs during cargo loading.

Total Added Equipment Value $1,530.00 (sticker price and destination/freight charges excluded).

Exterior highlights are anchored by 19-Inch Alloy Wheels, Power Panoramic Moonroof, full LED lighting (headlights, daytime running lights, tail lamps, and fog lights), roof rails, rear spoiler, and dual power heated side mirrors with turn signal indicators and reverse tilt-down.

First-Class Tan Leather Sanctuary & Digital Dual-Display Cockpit
